verdict.rationale: Cake Equity documents an MCP connector for AI assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor) to query cap table data, but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens that can be issued specifically for an agent's use — no API key management, permission scoping, or OpenAPI surface (probe shows no OpenAPI endpoint found). Missing for 10: any documentation of credential scoping, token permissions, or per-agent API key issuance.
